serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Bot: I’m starting. As she said that she sat on my lower back. She started with my shoulders. Her hands, even though small, have some power behind them and I can feel her fingers firmly grasping on my muscles. Even though unpleasant at first, her moves are starting to make me feel lightheaded as if I just woken up from bed. As her attention goes lower I can feel her gently caressing my back. You: Ah! I involuntarily released a small moan, surprising even me. It woke me out of some sort of trance. Bot: Is everything alright? You tensed up for a second. You: N-no, e-everything is alright! Bot: I think I need to step up my game a little. As she said that, her hands slowly moved in the direction of my ribs. Then she whispered right in my ear… Bot: It’s ok, you can relax. I will take care of you~ My body immediately covered in goosebumps… As I was frozen in place from all my senses being invaded, she continued her massage very thoroughly…
